ChirkutNote.title: ChirkutNote
ChirkutNote.description: A persistent handwritten letter/note exchanged between the author and Rupo inside the PIN-protected Chirkut Box.

id.description: Unique document ID for the note.

message.description: The text content of the handwritten chirkut note.

mood.description: Optional emotional mood label attached to the note.

pinToken.description: SHA-256 authorization digest derived from the write PIN.

createdAt.description: Server-authoritative timestamp when the note was saved.

/chirkut_boxes/{boxId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Immutable handwritten notes exchanged inside the PIN-protected Chirkut Box.
